info.title: Homework service
info.description: Division-scoped homework. Auth introspection on every request. Student drafts are private. Worker completions are fenced by generation and claim token. Settings require full organization admin. All JSON request fields are strict. upload_stale_seconds must be >= 2*presign_ttl_seconds.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Student-only numbered page mode, clamped to available pages.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Student page status; counters stay independent of this tab.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Student page: exact type name, or all.

200.description: Cursor mode: existing items with workspace/has_more/next_cursor. Student page mode: items with homework_id/name/type, deadline, own submission state/flags and result; counts {all,undone,in_review,revision,done}; pagination {current_page,total_pages,total_items,items_per_page}. Limit in page mode: 1..100, default 12. Empty results have current_page=total_pages=1. Page cannot be mixed with after/account_id/type_id/published.

get.description: Without page: existing cursor/workspace response. Student-only page mode: lightweight cards ordered by deadline/id, SQL counts across all status tabs under the same type/search filter, and numbered pagination. Scope is the authenticated account and selected organization/division. No per-card workspace hydration. Revision work remains included in undone, as in the existing student UI.
Scoped report and XLSX source: preserve nullable student class and native type_name. Foreign account/group/type IDs return 404 (unauthorized student account 403).

Requires monitoring.view. Scoped counters plus shared infrastructure only. processing_ready requires local broker, fresh worker heartbeat (30s) and successful fresh S3 Put/Get/Delete probe (60s). It does not promise completion of any particular job. Missing, stale and failed components never imply success.

post.description: Worker credential only, not Core key or bearer. Max body4096 bytes. UTC observed_at <=30s old/+5s future, strictly increasing per instance. Unknown storage has checked_at=null. No tenant/job/object/secret fields accepted. Success is not a business PDF completion. storage.checked_at must not be later than observed_at. Worker and Core credentials must be distinct.
